Name: Tired Elf Wizard - Nyapu Style
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
My first shot at pixel editing!

My aim: I wanted a wizard with a different vibe from Nyapu's older wizard but also not [i]too[/i] young. Elf ears solve most of it since elves look young anyway, and they are cute, but the wizard also strikes me as a guy who basically has never slept a day in his life. My solution: Bags under the eyes!

I have a few versions. There is one that just replaces SVE's wizard portrait and its seven frames. The other two are versions offered in Nyapu's younger wizard download, 14 and 32 frames. I've set the archives up to overwrite Nyapu's wizard portrait and SVE's wizard portrait, but depending on any wizard marriage mods you may have, you may have to move the file to replace the appropriate one for your mods. Hard to cover everything.

Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu[/url] for the lovely portraits and edit permissions!
